steps.title: Prevent background service destruction on activity finish
steps.description: Removed stopService call inside MainActivity onDestroy to ensure background audio service remains active when app is closed or removed.

steps.title: Implement back button backgrounding
steps.description: Updated onBackPressed to trigger moveTaskToBack, allowing continuous webview media session execution without terminating activity.

steps.title: Add task removal lifecycle handling in BackgroundAudioService
steps.description: Overrode onTaskRemoved in BackgroundAudioService so background playback continues uninterrupted when app is swiped away from recent apps list.
